title: HERMES Shared-Stream Recovery Phase-2 Shadow Adapter Config v1
description: Configuration contract for the FUTURE Phase-2 shadow adapter. DESIGN-ONLY; nothing here is loaded by any runtime today. Config lives in governed hermes_config (DB), NOT in code. shadow_enabled DEFAULTS DISABLED with no implicit enable. Every key: owner/type/allowed/default/fail-safe/source/reload/validation. No secrets. WO-HELM-HERMES-SHARED-STREAM-RECOVERY-PHASE2-SHADOW-ADAPTER-AND-EVIDENCE-CONTRACT-DESIGN-0001.

shadow_enabled.description: MASTER GATE. owner HERMES. DEFAULT false. fail-safe: absent/invalid -> disabled. source hermes_config. reload lifespan-init. No implicit enable anywhere.

shadow_consumer_live.description: MUST remain false in Phase 2. A true value is a validation error (no shadow reconnect is emittable).

shadow_eval_cadence_sec.description: Shadow eval max frequency. Aligned to watchdog_interval_sec. owner HERMES. fail-safe: invalid -> disabled.

heartbeat_soft_horizon_s.description: PROVISIONAL — OANDA heartbeat ~5s cadence basis; Phase-2 empirical calibration. fail-safe: invalid -> disabled.

heartbeat_hard_horizon_s.description: PROVISIONAL. MUST be >= soft. fail-safe: invalid -> disabled.

callback_dedup_window_sec.description: Debounce window for provider disconnect callbacks (bounding). A genuinely NEW connection-generation disconnect is never deduped away.

max_callback_shadow_events_per_min.description: Upper bound on callback-driven shadow evaluations per minute.

quorum_requires_all_validated_expected_f.description: Derived-authority quorum is ALL validated expected-flow instruments stale (architecture_v1 §6). Not tunable to a percentage.

log_sampling_ratio.description: 1.0 = log every decision; <1 samples AGREE_* only (divergences always logged).

evidence_output_path.description: Project-local append-only JSONL sink. NOT Redis/SQL (see §18). owner HERMES.

alert_on_comparison_classes.description: Comparison classes that raise an operator alert.
